goal: Adds Windows support to Bitcoin Core's IPC/multiprocess subsystem so bitcoin-node and bitcoin-gui can build and run there
Removes a platform gap blocking Windows users from process-separation features tracked in issue #28722
reviewability: Paused: the diff is explicitly marked DO NOT MERGE and rests on three unmerged upstream libmultiprocess PRs
Needs rebase and conflicts with over a dozen other open PRs, so review now risks being invalidated later
agreement: Nonblocking suggestion to combine with other PRs for easier testing, no objection raised (Sjors)
Author has repeatedly said other multiprocess PRs should be merged first, keeping this in draft by choice (ryanofsky)
No reviewer has re-engaged with the code since April 2025

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it enables an optional feature (IPC) on an already-supported platform rather than fixing existing build breakage
Value is incremental CI/vcpkg/depends plumbing for Windows+IPC, not a release-integrity fix

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it directly advances the process-separation project by adding Windows coverage to the core IPC stack
Also fixes concrete correctness and hang bugs found while porting, benefiting future Windows IPC users
Marginal today since there is no live consumer yet and the author deliberately keeps it in draft behind higher-priority PRs

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it extends the functional test framework and libmultiprocess unit tests so IPC tests can run on Windows at all
Test-only value that unblocks future coverage but does not itself catch a regression yet

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it fixes real bugs that would break the bitcoin wrapper tool's process exec logic on Windows
Matters once the wrapper is used on Windows with IPC, which is not yet a shipped default

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes concrete safety hazards in process-spawning primitives like a connect hang and a use-after-free causing heap corruption
These are subtle, risk-worthy bugs but confined to new Windows-only code paths with no current shipped consumer
